UO Paperdoll Project (Siege of Sosaria) Builder's Kit 3.1, by Zigholtul.
https://www.servuo.dev/archive/uo-paperdoll-project-siege-of-sosaria-builders-kit-pngs-etc-included.2426/
Downloaded 2026-10-02 by Chase (D:\UO\third-party\paperdoll-siege-of-sosaria\SOURCE.txt). No license file in the
download; terms none stated. Credit: Zigholtul, the UO Paperdoll Project. Vendored here by cc-P81 (2026-10-13).

What is here (SFW only; made by design\paperdoll-sos\tools\select.py from the kit, never by hand):
  ExternalImages\gumps\<id>.png   1,575 gump PNGs, into app\tazuo\ExternalImages\gumps\ (TazUO's gump override folder,
                                  beside Fiddle-Me-This's and ours):
                                    1,372  PNGs\#01 Default Gumps (its six body gumps are identical to the SFW swaps)
                                      121  PNGs\#03 Spell Icon Upgrades
                                       68  PNGs\DLC top level, without 9001 (0x2329, the author's own login splash;
                                           ours stays) and without 62000-62026 (Fiddle-Me-This's own gumps use those
                                           numbers for its XML gumps; listed in the cc-P81 notes)
                                       14  PNGs\DLC\Paperdoll Templates\#01 Default Versions\Grayscale (hueable)
  bodies-sfw\<id>.png             the six SFW body gumps (12, 13, 14, 15, 665, 666), into app\paperdoll-sfw\, so the
                                  launcher can put them back after a local NSFW swap (app\Paperdoll-Bodies.ps1).
  nsfw-sha256.txt                 SHA-256 of every Topless and Nude file in the kit that is not also an SFW file (the
                                  male templates' "topless" are the defaults). The package build refuses any file in
                                  the zip with one of these hashes. Hashes only: no art.

Never shipped: MUL Files\ (modified EA data), any Topless or Nude folder, the Animation VDs, Equipconv.def, BMPs\,
Gimp Files\, the TazUO paperdoll layout json (not needed; see the cc-P81 notes).
